entry.text: Researched, designed and implemented machine learning applications to solve business problems.
Worked on proofs of concept for innovative new solutions.
Devised and deployed predictive models using machine learning algorithms to drive business decisions.
Developed Handwritten Text Recognition using deep learning models combined with Tesseract OCR, enabling extraction from unstructured handwritten forms.

Built a Signature Detection system leveraging CNN-based object detection models to validate document authenticity.  Implemented checkbox detection using OpenCV and optimized image preprocessing techniques.
Enhanced product performance by profiling memory usage and implementing fixes, resulting in more efficient processing.
Financial Domain – Document AI & Image Intelligence
Designed solutions for printed character extraction and key-value pair identification from large volumes of financial/insurance documents.
Developed pattern-matching pipelines to automate value extraction based on customer-specific templates.

Implemented photo ID recognition workflows across diverse image formats to support compliance use cases.  Trained/fine-tuned signature detection models with new datasets, improving real-world accuracy.
